0.headline: Twenty-one picks, zero points, five rosters itching for fire
0.overview: Nobody has been voted out, so all five drafts sit at 0 pts with 114 on the table — this week is purely about construction. Austin owned the back-to-back turn twice, stacking picks #5 and #6, then #15 and #16, building a tidy themed four. Kylie spread hers evenly across every round. Tami used the first overall pick and her snake bookend, then inherited leftover #21 for a five-deep roster where only her best 4 count. Taylor front-loaded with #2 and closed with a wrestler. Tim went farmer, farmer, and never blinked.

lines.text: Austin turned the end of the snake into a shopping spree — Linnea and Jenna at #5 and #6, Carter and Eric at #15 and #16, four names, one very neat package.
Kylie's board reads like a boardroom gone feral: a chef at #3, Head of HR at #8, a criminal defense attorney at #13, and a game designer at #18 — one pick in every round, no wasted motion.
Tami opened the whole draft with Jelly at #1, doubled up at #10 and #11, and then leftover #21 handed her Sharonda — five castaways, best 4 count, the only roster with a spare tire.
Taylor grabbed 49-year-old Kristin at #2 and then built around motion — Ori, Ana, and Brady at #19 — crisis, cardio and chaos, exactly as advertised.
Tim took Lewis at #4 and Maggie at #7 and committed fully to the soil before adding Devin and Thien An — the most single-minded draft on the beach.

awards.label: Boldest draft
awards.text: Spending picks #4 and #7 on two farmers is a theme you can't walk back, Tim, and I respect the swagger.

awards.label: Safest draft
awards.text: One pick per round at #3, #8, #13 and #18 — Kylie built the most evenly spaced roster in the draft.
